expand.name: single-timed-inside-window
expand.description: A non-recurring timed event fully inside the window: one occurrence keyed by the event id.

expand.name: single-straddles-window-start
expand.description: Starts before the window and ends inside it: included (intersection is half-open).

expand.name: single-straddles-window-end
expand.description: Starts inside the window and ends after it: included.

expand.name: single-touching-window-edges-excluded
expand.description: One event ends exactly at window start, another starts exactly at window end: both excluded (half-open).

expand.name: single-all-day-in-local-window
expand.description: An all-day event is stored as UTC midnight..next UTC midnight; a Berlin-local day window (offset by the zone) still overlaps it.

expand.name: single-zero-duration
expand.description: A zero-length event inside the window is included (start < win.end && end > win.start).

expand.name: daily-berlin-spring-forward
expand.description: Daily 09:00 Europe/Berlin across 2026-03-29 (CET→CEST): wall clock stays 09:00, UTC shifts from 08:00Z to 07:00Z.

expand.name: daily-berlin-fall-back
expand.description: Daily 09:00 Europe/Berlin across 2026-10-25 (CEST→CET).

expand.name: daily-berlin-nonexistent-local-time
expand.description: Daily 02:30 Europe/Berlin: 2026-03-29 02:30 does not exist (clocks jump 02:00→03:00); records how the gap is resolved.

expand.name: daily-new-york-spring-forward
expand.description: Daily 08:30 America/New_York across 2026-03-08 (EST→EDT).

expand.name: daily-new-york-fall-back-late-evening
expand.description: Daily 23:30 America/New_York across 2026-11-01 (EDT→EST): the UTC instant crosses into the next UTC day.

expand.name: daily-moscow-2011-spring-forward-permanent
expand.description: Daily 09:00 Europe/Moscow across 2011-03-27, when Moscow moved from +03 to permanent +04 (historical tzdata).

expand.name: daily-moscow-2014-fall-back-permanent
expand.description: Daily 09:00 Europe/Moscow across 2014-10-26, when Moscow moved from +04 back to +03.

expand.name: daily-weekdays-filter
expand.description: FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR ('every weekday') over two Moscow weeks.

expand.name: daily-interval-3-overnight
expand.description: Every 3rd day 22:00–02:00 Berlin; the window starts at local midnight so the previous night's occurrence straddles it.

expand.name: weekly-byday-berlin-across-spring-forward
expand.description: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR 18:00 Berlin over three weeks spanning the March DST change.

expand.name: weekly-interval-2-byday-new-york
expand.description: FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU,TH 07:00 New York across the November DST change.

expand.name: weekly-plain-full-year-berlin
expand.description: FREQ=WEEKLY (weekday from DTSTART) 10:00 Berlin across a whole year: both DST transitions.

expand.name: monthly-on-31st-skips-short-months
expand.description: FREQ=MONTHLY from Jan 31 (Moscow): months without a 31st produce no occurrence.

expand.name: monthly-last-friday-new-york
expand.description: FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR 17:00 New York (an MCP-authored rule) across both DST changes.

expand.name: monthly-interval-2-bymonthday-berlin
expand.description: FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=2;BYMONTHDAY=15 08:00 Berlin.

expand.name: yearly-all-day-leap-day
expand.description: FREQ=YEARLY all-day from 2024-02-29: only leap years produce an occurrence.

expand.name: yearly-timed-summer-and-winter
expand.description: FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=1,7 (Berlin 20:00): one winter (+01) and one summer (+02) instance per year.

expand.name: count-5-daily
expand.description: FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5: exactly five occurrences even though the window is longer.

expand.name: count-counts-from-dtstart-not-window
expand.description: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU,TH;COUNT=6 with the window starting after the first four.

expand.name: until-equals-occurrence-instant-berlin
expand.description: UNTIL is compared in floating wall-clock space: UNTIL=06:00Z equals the real instant of the 2026-06-15 08:00 Berlin occurrence, but its floating time (08:00) is later, so it is NOT produced.

expand.name: until-floating-keeps-later-real-instant-new-york
expand.description: UNTIL=2026-06-15T23:00Z with a 21:00 New York series: the 06-15 occurrence is really 01:00Z on 06-16 (after UNTIL) but floating 21:00 < 23:00, so it IS produced (no recurrence_ends_at to prune it).

expand.name: recurrence-ends-at-prunes-open-rule
expand.description: An open-ended DAILY rule with recurrence_ends_at set: occurrences whose real start is after it are dropped.

expand.name: all-day-daily-ignores-event-zone-dst
expand.description: All-day DAILY with time_zone Europe/Berlin across the March DST change: expanded in UTC, every occurrence on UTC midnight.

expand.name: all-day-weekly-east-of-utc-window-edges
expand.description: All-day weekly SU,WE (UTC-midnight anchored, time_zone New York) against a Berlin local-week window, which starts at 23:00Z the day before: Sunday 02-01 overlaps the window's first hour and is included.

expand.name: overrides-cancel-and-modify
expand.description: Daily 09:00 Berlin with: a cancel (04-07), a title/location/category change (04-08), a time move later the same day (04-09), and an all-day conversion (04-10).

expand.name: overrides-moved-into-and-out-of-window
expand.description: Weekly MO 10:00 New York. The 05-04 occurrence (far outside the padded expansion) is moved INTO the window; the 05-25 occurrence (inside) is moved OUT of it; an override for another event id is ignored.

expand.name: override-modify-past-recurrence-end-still-renders
expand.description: A modify override on an occurrence after recurrence_ends_at: the occurrence is pruned in the main pass, so the 'moved in' pass renders it at its override time (current web behavior).

expand.name: override-cancel-across-dst-key
expand.description: Cancel keyed by the real instant of a post-DST occurrence (07:00Z, not 08:00Z) in a daily 09:00 Berlin series.

expand.name: multi-event-merge-sharing-and-series-fields
expand.description: Four events merged and sorted by start: shared-category derivation (private wins), the is_shared flag, and series-level fields (inactive, status, color, kind, task_id, hidden_from_public, attributes) copied onto every occurrence.

expand.name: split-series-berlin-retitled-and-moved
expand.description: Weekly MO,WE 17:00 Berlin split at the 2026-03-30 occurrence (after DST) with a new title and a 18:00 start; window spans the split.

expand.name: split-series-new-york-pruned-by-recurrence-ends-at
expand.description: Daily 21:00 New York split at 06-10 with no patch. The capped rule's UNTIL (real split - 1s) would still admit the 06-10 occurrence in floating space; recurrence_ends_at prunes it, so the new series alone owns 06-10 onward.

expand.name: split-series-count-becomes-open-ended
expand.description: Every-2-days COUNT=10 Moscow split at the 4th occurrence: the original swaps COUNT for UNTIL, the new series drops COUNT and is open-ended.

overrideInputs.name: cancel-occurrence
overrideInputs.description: cancelOccurrence: a cancel keyed by the original occurrence start, no patch.

overrideInputs.name: modify-occurrence
overrideInputs.description: modifyOccurrence: the patch is carried verbatim (null clears a field).

editAll.name: start-shifts-end
editAll.description: Moving start without end shifts end by the same delta (duration kept).

editAll.name: start-and-end
editAll.description: Explicit start and end are both taken as given.

editAll.name: falsy-values
editAll.description: allDay=false and inactive=false are real patch values, not absences.

editAll.name: empty
editAll.description: An empty patch yields an empty change set.

splitThisAndFuture.name: weekly-byday-no-patch
splitThisAndFuture.description: Original gets UNTIL = from - 1s; new series keeps BYDAY, starts at the split.

splitThisAndFuture.name: weekly-byday-with-patch
splitThisAndFuture.description: Patch start/title/category/inactive flow into the new series; end shifts with start.

splitThisAndFuture.name: explicit-end
splitThisAndFuture.description: An explicit patch end is used as-is.

splitThisAndFuture.name: count-replaced-by-until
splitThisAndFuture.description: COUNT is dropped on both halves; the original gets UNTIL instead.

splitThisAndFuture.name: until-replaced
splitThisAndFuture.description: An existing UNTIL is replaced on the original and removed on the new series.

splitThisAndFuture.name: non-recurring
splitThisAndFuture.description: A single event: both rrules stay null; recurrenceEndsAt is still set on the original.

capThisAndFuture.name: weekly-byday
capThisAndFuture.description: Weekly BYDAY series capped before an occurrence.

capThisAndFuture.name: count-becomes-until
capThisAndFuture.description: COUNT is replaced by UNTIL (buildRRule emits only one end).

capThisAndFuture.name: unsupported-freq-normalized
capThisAndFuture.description: A YEARLY rule round-trips through the form, which only knows DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY (falls back to WEEKLY) — current web behavior.
